_readme: Supplementary products that Utopia does not carry. Merged into the catalog with source='extra' and shown with a 'not at Utopia' badge. dept = department slug, subcat = subcategory English name. Add entries freely. departments: new departments (slotted in after `after`); extend: subcategories added to existing departments; moves: re-file source products whose name matches `match` (first match wins) from subcategory `from` into department `to` / `subcat`. A product with brand null reads as General. presets: named sets of { id, qty } a screen can add in one tap (expendables = the basic cart set).
